turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, I have been searching for a solution to this problem for months, and I have come to believe that you, Mr. Holmes, are the only one who can help me.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I am listening, your Majesty.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: My situation is this: I have a certain... acquaintance, a woman who has been involved in a most compromising affair with my brother, the Crown Prince of Bohemia.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I see, your Majesty. And what exactly is the nature of this affair?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: It is a matter of great delicacy, as I mentioned earlier. The woman in question, Irene Adler, has been seen with the Crown Prince on multiple occasions, and rumors are beginning to spread.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I am aware of the rumors, your Majesty. But what exactly is the nature of the affair between the Crown Prince and Miss Adler? Is it a mere rumor, or is there truth to it?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear it is no mere rumor, Mr. Holmes. The Crown Prince has been seen with her on several occasions, and I have reason to believe that they are... intimate.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: This is a serious matter, your Majesty. If the affair becomes public knowledge, it could lead to a major scandal and damage the reputation of the royal family.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am well aware of the potential consequences, Doctor. That is why I have come to you, Mr. Holmes, to see if you can help me resolve this matter discreetly.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I understand your concerns, your Majesty. But I must ask, what makes you think that I can help you resolve this matter?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I have heard that you have a reputation for being able to solve even the most complex and delicate cases, Mr. Holmes.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: And what exactly do you hope I can do, your Majesty?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I hope that you can find a way to discredit the rumors and protect the reputation of the royal family.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I see. And what is it that you are willing to do to achieve this goal, your Majesty?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am willing to do whatever it takes, Mr. Holmes. I will do anything to protect the reputation of my family.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: And what about Miss Adler, your Majesty? What role does she play in all of this?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that she is at the center of the whole affair, Doctor. She is the one who has been seen with the Crown Prince on multiple occasions.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I see. And what do you know about Miss Adler, your Majesty?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I know that she is a woman of great intelligence and cunning, Mr. Holmes. She is not someone to be underestimated.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: And what do you propose we do next, your Majesty?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
